title: Practice 1: Holding on, settling in, coming round

blocks.text: Sentences and their English: Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR). Words, meanings and how each word is built: the English Wiktionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: What does у- add in удержа́ть (“to retain, to hold, to withhold”)?
options: moving away from, leaving a place by the action of the base verb
making the object as many times bigger as the base numeral says
covering the object completely with something by the action of the base verb
keeping in the state the base verb names
exercises.why: The Russian Wiktionary lists удержа́ть under this meaning of у-. Source: Russian Wiktionary, «у-», meaning 5 (https://ru.wiktionary.org/wiki/у-).

exercises.q: What does у- add in устоя́ть (“to keep one's balance, to remain on one's feet, to stand one's ground, to stand fast”)?
options: moving away from, leaving a place by the action of the base verb
keeping in the state the base verb names
making the object as many times bigger as the base numeral says
destroying or using up the object by the action of the base verb
exercises.why: The Russian Wiktionary lists устоя́ть under this meaning of у-. Source: Russian Wiktionary, «у-», meaning 5 (https://ru.wiktionary.org/wiki/у-).

options: устоя́ть
предстоя́ть
состоя́ть
exercises.why: **устоять** — устоя́ть (perfective): to keep one's balance, to remain on one's feet, to stand one's ground, to stand fast; to resist, to withstand, to stand up (against). Wiktionary: у- + стоя́ть.
exercises.context: Which prefix? The English says which word it is.

options: устоя́ть

exercises.q: What does за- add in задержа́ть (“to hold up, detain, to hold back, to stop”)?
options: perfectivizes verbs
describing an action that implies the existence of barriers, obstacles, or hindrance
to begin doing
describing an intensified or extreme action or an action of doing something up to the point that an object becomes junk
exercises.why: Wiktionary lists задержа́ть under this meaning of за-. Source: Wiktionary, «за-» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/за-#Russian).

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to retain, to hold, to withhold
to keep one's balance, to remain on one's feet, to stand one's ground, to stand fast
to hold oneself back, to restrain oneself
to hold up, detain, to hold back, to stop
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: удержа́ть — to retain, to hold, to withhold; устоя́ть — to keep one's balance, to remain on one's feet, to stand one's ground, to stand fast; утерпе́ть — to hold oneself back, to restrain oneself; задержа́ть — to hold up, detain, to hold back, to stop.

options: вы́держать
задержа́ть
одержа́ть
exercises.why: **задержал** — задержа́ть (perfective): to hold up, detain, to hold back, to stop; to delay, to check; to arrest, to detain; to slow down, to retard, to delay, to hamper. Wiktionary: за- + держа́ть.
exercises.context: Which prefix? The English says which word it is.

options: задержа́ть
вы́держать
одержа́ть
exercises.why: **задержан** — задержа́ть (perfective): to hold up, detain, to hold back, to stop; to delay, to check; to arrest, to detain; to slow down, to retard, to delay, to hamper. Wiktionary: за- + держа́ть.
exercises.context: Which prefix? The English says which word it is.

exercises.q: What does у- add in усе́сться (“to sit down (comfortably), to take a seat”)?

making the object as many times bigger as the base numeral says
moving away from, leaving a place by the action of the base verb
settling or placing something thoroughly, comfortably or for long
